skill.name: bid-on-new-customers
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to identify first paid orders from supported store records and set up new customer conversions for Google Ads, Meta, or ChatGPT Ads. Review the setup and select the campaign goal yourself.
skill.summary: Set up first-order conversions for campaigns that prioritize new customers.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance flags describe store order history and authorized product workflows, not host discovery. The audit confirms risks from account writes, order reads, an unpinned installer, and live vendor integrations. The skill requests some credentials and trusts remote workflow instructions and browser links without adequate safeguards.

remediation.issue: The workflow asks users to supply API credentials directly.
remediation.suggestion: Use a verified vendor credential form, OAuth, or a secret reference. Keep credentials out of chat, tool arguments, and logs.

remediation.issue: Setup writes can occur without approval of the account scope or proposed changes.
remediation.suggestion: Preview the target account, storefront, and exact changes. Ask for approval before writing, and verify the resulting state before any retry.

remediation.issue: Order verification may retrieve more data than an aggregate check needs.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the requested company and storefront. Use counts or minimal fields by default, and request approval before retrieving individual orders.

remediation.issue: Live vendor pages and MCP results can influence agent actions.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, versioned copy of the workflow. Treat remote content as data and require separate approval for new operations or destinations.

remediation.issue: The workflow relays browser handoff URLs without checking their destinations.
remediation.suggestion: Verify HTTPS, the expected provider origin, and the destination account before sharing the link. Stop if any check fails.

remediation.issue: The installer command does not pin the package or skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill revision. Verify their provenance and obtain explicit approval before downloading or running the installer.

content.value_statement: A purchase goal can prioritize repeat orders when your campaign is meant to attract new buyers. This skill guides you through using first paid orders as a separate conversion with Product Metrics.
actual_capabilities: Explain how supported stores use paid-order history to classify customers as new, returning, or unknown.
Read Product Metrics setup status to identify the connected store, advertising channel, and outstanding steps.
Find setup guidance for Shopify, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Magento, Shopware, and Cloudflare-tracked sites.
Compare first-order revenue and profit conversions and explain when each is available.
Guide users through selecting a conversion goal in Google Ads, Meta, or ChatGPT Ads.
Check recent orders for customer classification and margin when the connected account permits access.
limitations: Live checks require an authorized Product Metrics connection. Without one, the skill can explain the setup.
The user must select the campaign goal in the ad platform. The skill does not make a conversion primary.
Cloudflare page tracking does not provide the order history needed to verify first purchases.
Unmatched guest orders do not qualify as new. Profit conversions require active additional costs and complete order costs.

use_cases.title: Check store readiness
use_cases.description: Find out how your store identifies first paid orders and which setup steps remain before you use those orders for bidding.

use_cases.title: Choose a campaign conversion
use_cases.description: Compare first-order revenue and profit goals, then identify what to change manually in your ad account.

use_cases.title: Verify order classification
use_cases.description: Check how many recent paid orders were classified as new, returning, or unknown without sharing customer identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Understand First-Order Conversions
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn how new customer tracking works before connecting an account.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what Product Metrics counts as a new customer for [store platform]. Which paid orders are excluded? Use the documentation only.

prompt_templates.title: Review Tracking Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Check an existing connection without changing settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: For [company] and [storefront], check the Product Metrics setup status for [ad channel]. List completed steps and remaining steps. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Conversion Goal Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare revenue and profit goals before changing a campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: For [store platform] and [ad channel], compare first-order revenue and profit goals. List the prerequisites and the settings I must change myself. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Recent Order Signals
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate customer classifications before selecting a campaign goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm the company and storefront before checking the last [number] paid orders. Report aggregate counts of new, returning, and unknown classifications. Do not display identifiers or change settings.

output_examples.input: What happens when WooCommerce cannot match a paid guest order to customer history?
output_examples.output: The customer classification stays unknown. Product Metrics can still report purchase revenue, but it does not send a new customer conversion for that order.

output_examples.input: Which Google Ads goal should I select if I want to optimize for first-order profit?
output: Check that additional costs are active and that paid orders have complete costs.
In Google Ads, make Product Metrics - New Customer Profit primary and make the old purchase action secondary.
Confirm the action status under Goals, then Conversions.

output_examples.input: Can a Cloudflare-tracked site send a verified first-order conversion?
output_examples.output: No. Page tracking records the purchase but does not include prior order history. Use a supported purchase or profit conversion instead.

best_practices: Confirm the storefront and ad account before checking live setup or order data.
Check that required marketing and analytics consent is in place before sending conversion events.
Verify that first-order conversions are arriving before changing the campaign goal.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys or access tokens into chat.
Do not count a pending order or an unmatched guest order as a verified first purchase.
Do not assume that creating a secondary conversion action changes bidding.

faq.question: What counts as a new customer?
faq.answer: A paid order counts as new when Product Metrics finds no earlier paid order for that customer in the store's available history.

faq.question: Can guest orders count as new?
faq.answer: WooCommerce, Magento, and Shopware can match guest orders by email. An order that cannot be matched stays unclassified.

faq.question: Does Cloudflare tracking support this conversion?
faq.answer: No. Cloudflare page tracking shows the purchase but does not give Product Metrics access to prior store orders.

faq.question: When is the first-order profit conversion available?
faq.answer: Product Metrics sends it when additional costs are active and the order has complete cost data.

faq.question: Who selects the campaign conversion?
faq.answer: You select it in the ad platform. Agent-created Google Ads actions remain secondary until you change their status.

faq.question: What happens after a refund?
faq.answer: Product Metrics adjusts the Google Ads conversion. A later refund does not change the original Meta event.
